source_identity.prior_record_policy: The earlier archive/image/batch/prefetch and release-archive evidence remains unchanged and applies only to its recorded sources. This newer record adds ownership validation, not a retroactive extension of the old preflight.

implemented_contracts.ownership: PendingFrameBatch owns Task; Drop immediately sets AtomicBool before task cancellation; the background worker never owns the result slot strongly.
implemented_contracts.cancellation: Queued requests cancel on source/size replacement, missing/failed source, zero drawable area or element-state drop. A synchronous frame or preparation already executing is non-preemptible; checks before preparation and between/after frame attempts discard retired partial output and do not reinsert observed-cancelled prepared assets.
implemented_contracts.per_element: One pending request per live element and one worker lane retained across source/size replacement. Replacements asynchronously wait for an old in-flight frame to return.
implemented_contracts.process_admission: Two active element-owned workers, permits held inside each worker until synchronous completion. Existing per-batch 256 MiB output admission therefore permits at most 512 MiB of output for active batches. Completed ready batches and accepted per-element caches, posters, prepared assets, source bytes, renderer/layer/image scratch, other callers and allocator overhead are additional. This is not a unified global memory budget or hard RSS limit.
implemented_contracts.geometry: Changing current size retires pending work before polling; poll also rejects a batch whose requested size differs from current cache size. Source identity replacement clears pending and cached frames.
implemented_contracts.throughput: Fixed two-worker default deliberately limits aggregate element rendering throughput; foreground scheduling remains unblocked while permits are unavailable. Ready results release worker admission so finite queued waiters can progress.

red.source: Baseline production behavior plus the new real-frame regression, before production edits.
red.observed: A real ready 1x1 batch resets the already-current 2x2 cache back to 1x1.

controlled_executor_cases: Queued element-state drop immediately retires output slot, then task cleanup releases weak animation source without rendering or notification.
Source replacement and resize retain the same lane, cancel queued old tasks, and accept only real frames for current geometry.
Three queued requests with two occupied slots allow independent foreground progress; dropping one and releasing one slot completes both survivors without ready-result admission hoarding.

A real one-pixel background frame pauses inside its synchronous poll; dropping owner and running cancellation cleanup does not release lane/global admission or source until that poll returns, and no obsolete result or notification is published.
Cancellation before rendering avoids preparation; cancellation after two real frames drops partial output and prepared cache entry; a subsequent render reparses and progresses.
Real ready old-geometry output is discarded instead of resetting current cache geometry; its image weak reference expires.
Previous batch aggregate admission, exact fitted canvas geometry, adaptive prefetch/playback and prepared-cache reuse/LRU tests remain green.
reproduction.qualification: TestAppContext/TestDispatcher controlled scheduling, including a real background thread paused after a genuine one-pixel frame. This proves task/permit ownership and finite-waiter progress, not production frame-clock timing or strict fairness under unlimited arrivals.

limitations: A synchronous frame, decode or preparation already executing cannot be preempted. Retired work keeps its worker and element-lane admission until synchronous completion and releases partial output when cancellation is observed.
